scientific_integrity: All universal statements have an analytic argument; finite checker tests are supplementary only. Previously known regular-simplex and random-projection special cases are cited, not claimed as new. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only equifacial, full-dimensional three-dimensional tetrahedra and Haar-uniform planes through the centroid. No noncentral plane, arbitrary tetrahedron, section-area, or full shape law is asserted. The quadratic expansion is local, not a global optimally sharp inequality. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp Schur ordering of triangular central sections of equifacial tetrahedra
